ordered_diagnoses: Ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute loss of consciousness with preceding palpitations and visual disturbances
salient_findings: Syncope with preceding palpitation and amaurosis
Polymorphic ventricular tachycardia during presyncope episode
Diffuse stenosis in proximal to mid-LAD and stenosis in mid-right coronary artery
key_facts: Previous episode of syncope 1 month prior
Vital signs: blood pressure 125/96 mm Hg, pulse rate 81 beats/min, respiratory rate 18 breaths/min, and oxygen saturation 99% under ambient air
Normal laboratory tests, including blood glucose, electrolytes, D-dimer, troponin I, and N-terminal pro–B-type natriuretic peptide
12-lead 24-hour Holter monitoring recorded polymorphic ventricular tachycardia during presyncope episode
Coronary Angiography showed 50% to 90% diffuse stenosis in proximal to mid-LAD and 80% stenosis in mid-right coronary artery

shortlist: Ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease

shortlist.label: Ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has significant coronary artery stenosis and experienced syncope with polymorphic ventricular tachycardia

shortlist.label: Acute coronary syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has significant coronary artery stenosis and experienced syncope with polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, suggesting possible acute myocardial ischemia

shortlist.label: Long QT syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a QTc of 403 milliseconds, which is slightly prolonged and may contribute to the development of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia

shortlist.label: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient experienced polymorphic ventricular tachycardia during presyncope episode, which is a characteristic feature of this condition

shortlist.label: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient experienced polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, which can be a feature of this condition, although the presence of significant coronary artery disease makes it less likely

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of syncope and palpitations, combined with the Holter monitoring results showing polymorphic ventricular tachycardia during a presyncope episode, are consistent with this diagnosis. The normal electrocardiogram and echocardiography results, as well as the lack of evidence of acute myocardial ischemia, also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease
rejected.why: While the patient has significant coronary artery disease, the symptoms and Holter monitoring results suggest an arrhythmic cause of syncope rather than an ischemic one.

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's laboratory tests, including troponin I, were normal, and there was no evidence of acute myocardial ischemia.

rejected.label: Long QT syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's QTc interval was 403 milliseconds, which is not significantly prolonged.

rejected.label: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: There is no evidence of right ventricular dysfunction or structural abnormalities on the echocardiogram.
